title: Drive Fusion failure-rate factors
note: Multipliers on a drive's base AFR (PLAN §8.2). Each is 1.0 when its input is unknown, so a missing fact never lowers a rate. Ranges are [from, to) with to = null meaning no upper bound. The values are Drive Fusion's own judgement, informed by the shape of published fleet statistics (infant mortality, a flat middle, wear-out from year 4); they are not measured and should be revised as data allows. Version 2 adds the correlation multipliers for copies that can fail together (PLAN §8.2, ROADMAP M5.5).

correlation.note: P(loss) of content on drive set D is the product of the drives' AFRs, times same_batch^(k-1) for each group of k drives sharing a batch and same_zone^(k-1) for each group sharing a disaster zone, capped at the lowest single AFR (all copies can't be likelier to go than the safest one). Drives whose zone is unknown are assumed to share one: most collections sit in one place, and assuming otherwise would make them look safer. A batch needs the same maker, model and purchase month, so an unknown batch is not assumed shared.
